sections.section_title: DCMIPP minimum requirements for frame structure
sections.text_helper: Section 39.3.5 "DCMIPP minimum requirements for frame structure" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1825.
sections.section_content:
DCMIPP imposes the following minimum requirements for the frame architecture:
Blanking phase
• Dump pipe
– The minimal duration of the blanking between two frames must be an equivalent of
666 datawords of 32 bits
• Pixel pipe
– Vertical blanking: minimum is 5 lines. If the line is less than 12 pixels, a minimum
of 24 pixels equivalent for the vertical blanking parameter is requested
– Horizontal blanking: a minimum duration of 12 pixels is required between two lines
Data image area
• Vertical image area: minimum one line (two lines if raw Bayer conversion is active)
• Horizontal image area: minimum two pixels
• The minimum total frame size is fixed to 36 pixels
